facts.fact: Togo's finance ministry says BIOSECU-CRT, an online facial-recognition proof-of-life check for the 40,043 public-sector pensioners of the Caisse de Retraites du Togo, was put into service on 16 November 2026, with enrolment open to 16 February 2027.

systems.platform: reuses the CNSS BIOSECU system built with LIKSOFT
